propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks large bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) when signed by unpinned developer environments, even if the plan review passed, because the not-pinned arm returns an affirmative 'mismatch' verdict classified as FLAG/BLOCK.

No executable path exists for a contributor to obtain a prod-attested plan-review attestation: the opcert service has no client in the repo, cannot persist returned envelopes, and requires an SSM guard key.

The cross-host source-of-certification verification chain (trusted_env_keyring lookup + verify_opcert call) enforces provenance gating rather than factual completion of a review, making the criterion unsatisfiable for any locally-reviewed bug when no developer environment is pinned.

Subject binding (ticket_id and kind verification) must be retained to prevent attestation replay across tickets or kind-mismatches, but provenance verification via pinned keyring should be removed because the trust root is unreachable for contributors.

The gate should accept any factual, well-formed, subject-bound, lifecycle-valid plan-review attestation regardless of signing environment provenance, falling back to the fail-open default for unknown verdict types.
